name: rowCumprods
title: Cumulative products for each row in a matrix

origin.description: Cumulative products for each row in a matrix.
origin.usage:
rowCumprods(x, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, dim. = dim(x), ...,
  useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An NxK matrix or, if dim. is specified, an N * K vector.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: dim.
arguments.text: An integer vector of length two specifying the dimension of x, also when not a matrix. The argument is named with a period because dim is reserved.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: Returns a numeric NxK matrix of the same mode as x. When x is logical, the values are read as 0 and 1 and the result is integer. An integer product outside [-2147483647, 2147483647] is NA_integer_ for that cell and for every later cell in the same row, and a warning is signaled. A zero keeps the later products at zero. A negative value flips the sign.
origin.value: A matrix with one row for each selected row and one column for each selected column. The entry in column j is the product of the selected columns 1 through j in that row.

translation.description: Cumulative products for each row in a matrix.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An N by K array, or a one-dimensional vector when dim is given. A two-dimensional array is read with axis 0 as rows and axis 1 as columns, matching the printed R matrix. Logical, integer, and floating values are accepted.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based rows to include. None uses every row. Zeros are dropped and negative values exclude, as in R.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based columns to include, in the order given. None uses every column. The cumulative product walks this order.

arguments.name: dim
arguments.text: Two integers giving the shape of x, also when x is not a matrix. This is dim. When x is one-dimensional, the values fill that shape in column-major order.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for compatibility with useNames. It must be TRUE or FALSE and does not change the numbers. Names are not attached.

translation.details: The products come from the rowcumprods crate, ported from matrixStats src/rowCumprods.c with byrow TRUE. Double products are ordinary IEEE multiplies, so Inf, NaN, and signed zeros follow that arithmetic. Integer and logical input return int32. Logical TRUE is 1 and FALSE is 0. A missing integer is the minimum int32, R's NA_integer_. A product outside [-2147483647, 2147483647] becomes that missing value for the rest of the row, and a warning is issued.
translation.value: An array with one row for each selected row and one column for each selected column. Floating input returns float64. Integer and logical input return int32.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowcumprods import rowCumprods

x = np.array([[1, 5, 9], [2, 6, 10], [3, 7, 11], [4, 8, 12]], dtype=np.int32)
rowCumprods(x)
